All Goals

Weekly Routine

Strength

A conjugate-influenced powerlifting split dedicates individual days to the squat, bench, and deadlift patterns and uses accessory work to strengthen the specific weaknesses that limit each lift. Training each primary movement once per week at high intensity allows full nervous system recovery — the primary constraint in maximum-strength development. Accessory days address lagging muscle groups and reinforce the skill components of the big three.

5-Day Schedule

Day 1 Squat — Primary + Accessory
  1. 1 Barbell Back Squat
  2. 2 Hack Squat
  3. 3 Romanian Deadlift
  4. 4 Leg Curl (Machine)
  5. 5 Leg Extension
Day 2 Bench — Primary + Accessory
  1. 1 Barbell Bench Press
  2. 2 Close-Grip Bench Press
  3. 3 Barbell Overhead Press
  4. 4 Dips
  5. 5 Skull Crusher
Day 3 Deadlift — Primary + Accessory
  1. 1 Barbell Deadlift
  2. 2 Barbell Good Morning
  3. 3 Barbell Bent-Over Row
  4. 4 Pull-Up
  5. 5 Seated Cable Row
Day 4 Upper Accessory — Shoulders & Arms
  1. 1 Barbell Overhead Press
  2. 2 Barbell Incline Bench Press
  3. 3 Dumbbell Lateral Raise
  4. 4 Barbell Curl
  5. 5 Cable Face Pull
Day 5 Lower Accessory — Posterior Chain
  1. 1 Goblet Squat
  2. 2 Barbell Glute Bridge
  3. 3 Romanian Deadlift
  4. 4 Leg Curl (Machine)
  5. 5 Standing Calf Raise
